fullContentHtml:
RPSC Assistant Professor Result 2026 – Full Details

Rajasthan Public Service Commission (RPSC) has released the result for the Assistant Professor Post. This recruitment was released for 575 posts. The applications for RPSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 20 September 2025 to 19 October 2025. The written examination was held From 07-20 December 2025. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their RPSC Assistant Professor Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 18 September 2025
  • Application Start Date : 20 September 2025
  • Last Date : 19 October 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 19 October 2025
  • Correction Date : 09 October 2025
  • Exam Date : 07-20 December 2025
  • Exam City : 30 November 2025
  • Admit Card : 04 December 2025
  • Answer Key : 20 January 2026
  • Result : 23 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General / Other State : Rs. 600/-
  • OBC / BC : Rs. 400/-
  • SC / ST : Rs. 400/-
  • Correction Charge : Rs. 500/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is RPSC Assistant Professor Result 2026?

RPSC Assistant Professor Result 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
